sentences.text: She liked to sit alone in the school cafeteria.
She watched her classmates laugh and talk.
She often wrote in her diary.
Her diary was her best friend.
It listened to her thoughts and dreams.
One day, a new boy came to school.
He was tall and had dark hair.
"Hi, I’m Alex," he said with a smile.
They talked about music and books.
As weeks passed, Sam and Alex spent more time together.
Sam told Alex about her diary.
"I write everything in it," she said.
"You should let me read it one day!" he joked.
She had a fight with her best friend, Lily.
Lily was angry because Sam spent time with Alex.
Sam wrote in her diary about her feelings.
The next day, Alex noticed Sam was quiet.
She wanted to tell him everything.
Later that week, Sam decided to invite Alex to her house.
She wanted to show him her diary.
What if he didn’t like it?
He smiled and said, "This is amazing!"
She was happy to share her thoughts.
After that day, Sam felt different.
She was not just a wallflower anymore.
She had a friend who understood her.
Sam learned that it was okay to be herself.
Sam wrote in her diary, "Today was a good day.
Sam smiled as she closed her diary.
She knew she had a friend in Alex, and that made all the difference.
